name: yoast-duplicate-post
notes: Adapter-authoring probe 2026-08-22: inspected the official WordPress.org Yoast Duplicate Post 4.7 artifact (SHA-256 8cbeebf7c2ee982d2ae33833088ba8ac2391cc316a4dd71800a07f5fa128b418). src/admin/options.php is the closed 28-setting registry reproduced below; admin-functions.php supplies the matching defaults and the separate duplicate_post_version upgrade gate.

The 28 registered options are portable duplication policy and UI choices. Every 0|1 scalar or nested flag is lint_ok because its value space collides with ordinary low WordPress ids but the inspected consumers cast it only as a boolean/number. Role, post-type, taxonomy, and meta-key lists contain stable names, not local database ids.

_dp_original is durable per-copy provenance used by common-functions.php and the original-post UI; it is a real post reference and therefore requires the original post inside capture scope. The four rewrite-and-republish keys are in-progress workflow state and stay runtime, including _dp_has_rewrite_republish_copy even though its runtime value is numerically reference-shaped.

The adapter deliberately declares no delete semantics for duplicated posts and no migration of an in-progress Rewrite & Republish session. It remains experimental until clone behavior, the original link, and settings render are exercised on a clean target at the exact artifact boundary.
